entries.subject: ESA/Webb weic2209a
entries.finding: Webb's First Deep Field (NIRCam Image): Webb NIRCam, six filters from 0.9 to 4.4 µm, the shortest wavelengths blue and the longest red; 4537 × 4630 px over 2.27 arcmin, CC BY 4.0. The file's embedded sky tags, used as they are: 0.02999 arcsec per pixel, north 35.0° left of vertical, the frame's centre at 110.8277933°, -73.4539034°. Not measured against Gaia here; the same publishers' tags were within 0.4 arcsec on four cluster pictures and 1.5 arcsec off on one deep field.
